gloss: to pass through; to get through (danger)

definitions.gloss: to pass through; to slip under
definitions.explanation: To go through or under something low or narrow and come out the other side: a gate, a fence, a crowd.

definitions.gloss: to get through; to survive (danger, hardship)
definitions.explanation: To come safely through a danger, a crisis or a hard test.

examples.english: He came through many brushes with death on the battlefield.

notes:
Often written くぐり{抜|ぬ}ける. From くぐる (to pass under) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to come out the other side).

TRANSITIVITY:
A motion verb: ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks the place or the danger passed through (⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}り{抜|ぬ}ける), not an object acted on.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- くぐる: to pass under or through; says nothing about coming out the other side
- ⟦{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける→通り抜ける：14422_toorinukeru⟧: to pass through an open space (a park, a street)
- ⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}ける→切り抜ける：16750_kirinukeru⟧: to get out of a difficulty by one's own effort
